title: Gooloo A3 Jump Starter 3000A with Air Compressor US$41.47 (~A$59.33) AU Stock Delivered @ GOOLOO Global Warehouse AliExpress
body:
Deal: Gooloo A3 Jump Starter 3000A with Air Compressor US$41.47 (~A$59.33) AU Stock Delivered @ GOOLOO Global Warehouse AliExpress

[Lizard Spock] I have this and it's been incredibly useful. It allowed me to start my boat's outboard about 6 times and only depleted the battery by about 25%. The tyre inflator is a great little bonus too. So much easier than bringing out the air compressor for inflating bikes, car tyres and balls.
[Knightchampion] I bought this item on the night of 1st August. It somehow got delivered on the 4th. Fastest delivery of an item from AliExpress I've experienced.
[Clear] It would have shipped from Amazon. Stores can put stock in Amazon and have it FBA without actually having an Amazon storefront. In this case Gooloo have a storefront there.
[ilikegengar] Got it from the last deal. Fast shipping and managed to jump my very dead battery on a cold morning. Would recommend
[Naigrabzo] Can it jump start an EV with dead 12V battery?
[bargainisg8] My question to AI
can Gooloo A3 Jump Starter start Ev 13v battery?
AI answers
Yes, the GOOLOO A3 Jump Starter can safely wake up or jump-start an electric vehicle's low-voltage auxiliary battery (commonly referred to as a 12V or ~13V battery).
[bargainisg8] You're welcome very intelligent internet user.
[BargainBragster] How did you get it for $53.45 compared to deal posted above? Please share the hack or details.
[Satellite] This item cannot be shipped at selected region . :(
[Clear] You may need to add your shipping address to your account first before it shows.
[twister292] Thanks! ordered one for the wife's car that hasn't been driven in a while, the battery is sufficient to unlock doors etc but not cranking. Will use this to start it up and take it for a good drive to charge it. Might also connect a trickle charger if needed.
[lomie] Charge it up properly with a smart charger. At least there's some monitoring and conditioning happening with a multi-stage charger than just outright driving the car just to charge the battery. You're not wasting fuel either. And don't use a trickle charger (assuming it is of the 'dumb charger' variety).
[twister292] Thanks! duly noted :)
Would this be ok as a charger?
https://amzn.asia/d/0gsAmLRU
[cooltrick] I've had mine for a few months now and it's already rescued me multiple times. Started a 3.0litre turbo diesel no worries. When you're far from anywhere you'll be glad you've got something like this. Also the inflator is a ripper.
